what_changed: Claude Fable 5 released — new top-tier model above Opus with larger context and stronger coding/tool use
why_it_matters: Older Claude 3 models are several generations behind on coding, tool calling, and context window.

what_changed: gpt-3.5-turbo is legacy; current models are substantially better at code and support larger contexts
why_it_matters: Legacy models hallucinate more on code and lack modern tool-calling support.

what_changed: React 19 stable — Actions, use() hook, and the compiler remove most manual memoization
why_it_matters: Hand-written useMemo/useCallback plumbing is largely obsolete with the React compiler.

what_changed: CRA is deprecated; the React team recommends Vite or a framework (Next.js, Remix)
why_it_matters: CRA receives no updates; Vite dev server starts in milliseconds instead of tens of seconds.

what_changed: Node 16/18 are end-of-life; Node 22 is the active LTS with built-in watch mode, test runner, and fetch
why_it_matters: EOL Node versions get no security patches, and the built-in test runner removes a dependency.

what_changed: Moment.js is in maintenance mode; its own docs recommend alternatives
new_option: date-fns or the built-in Temporal API
why_it_matters: Moment is large, mutable, and frozen; Temporal is now landing in browsers natively.

what_changed: Python 3.14 released with free-threaded (no-GIL) builds officially supported
why_it_matters: 3.9 is near end-of-life; modern typing syntax and big interpreter speedups came after it.

what_changed: Completions-style prompting is legacy; structured outputs with JSON schema are the reliable way to get parseable results
why_it_matters: Regex-parsing free-text model output is a bug factory when a schema-constrained mode exists.
